items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘解释无线电抱怨：降挡不可接受
items.summaryZh: 维斯塔潘在圣保罗站首节练习中排名第三，落后使用升级版迈凯伦的诺里斯超过0.2秒；他在无线电中抱怨降挡感觉不理想，并解释发声是为了让红牛保持警觉。

items.originalTitle: "Unacceptable downshifts" – Max Verstappen explains what's behind a recurring F1 radio complaint
items.summaryEn: Verstappen finished third in the opening practice session in Sao Paulo, just over two tenths behind fastest man Lando Norris in the upgraded McLaren. He complained over the team radio about a less-than-ideal feeling during downshifts, explaining that speaking out is meant to keep Red Bull on its toes.
detailZh: “不可接受的降挡”——马克斯·维斯塔潘解释F1无线电中反复出现的抱怨背后原因
维斯塔潘表示，他在车队无线电中发声的主要目的是让红牛保持警觉。不过在巴西，降挡并不是这位四届世界冠军唯一的抱怨。
维斯塔潘在圣保罗F1周末的首节练习中排名第三，落后使用升级版迈凯伦的最快车手诺里斯超过0.2秒，该赛车带有新前翼，该前翼是2027年的基准。
尽管从绝对速度看开局看起来有希望，但维斯塔潘对周五下午他的小红牛22的驾驶感受并不完全满意。车队无线电中出现了这位四届世界冠军经常发出的抱怨：降挡时感觉不理想。
“不可接受，伙计。不可接受，这些降档。搞什么鬼！”，维斯塔潘在首节练习赛中对比赛工程师汤姆·哈特说道。哈特本周末再次顶替詹皮耶罗·兰比亚塞，两人继续为未来培养合作关系。
尽管维斯塔潘知道这听起来像是在抱怨，但他在巴西解释说，这类无线电信息主要源于他的完美主义，目的是让车队在比赛周末真正关键的时刻保持警惕。
“你听到我抱怨的换挡或其他什么，只是因为我从不满足，因为我认为某些事情总是可以做得更好”，维斯塔潘解释道。
“我总是试图微调或寻找改进。所以，如果你听起来像是在抱怨或别的什么，那更多是为了让我确保车队始终关注细节，努力寻找更多圈速，因为我知道其中还有更多圈速潜力。”
降挡时的感觉不仅仅关乎换挡本身，还涉及它可能导致的赛车不稳定——尤其是车尾。这主要发生在制动时，并且与车手对赛车的信心有关，这意味着在这方面也可能损失圈速。这解释了为什么维斯塔潘一直强调这个问题，以及为什么这个话题每个比赛周末都会被提起。
练习起步时与斯特罗尔的事件解释
然而在英特拉格斯，首节练习赛中的问题不止于此。维斯塔潘还抱怨转向手感沉重，这似乎指向动力转向系统的问题。红牛承认该问题在数据中也能看到，随后维斯塔潘在前往维修区时开玩笑说：“用这个转向简直是在健身！”
虽然维斯塔潘因为转向问题不得不更费力地驾驶，但第一节练习赛中最极端的例子出现在兰斯·斯特罗尔身上。这位加拿大车手的车载画面显示，他在连续三个弯角中几乎打满了转向锁，这在赛道的那些位置绝对不正常。
在练习赛结束时，维斯塔潘和斯特罗尔在练习起步的位置争夺中再次相遇。红牛车手已收到车队指示，要在两次烧胎后于发车格右侧进行练习起步，由于理想行车线的关系，那一侧的抓地力水平自然有所不同。
斯特罗尔想超越维斯塔潘，为自己抢占那个特定的发车格位置。然而，这位荷兰车手毫不相让，再次超越了阿斯顿·马丁车手，随后斯特罗尔接受失败，不得不在左侧——发车格较脏的一侧——进行练习起步。
红牛终于解决无线电问题了吗？
在墨西哥以及到目前为止在巴西，另一个问题似乎有所改善：车队无线电。这个问题在新加坡和奥斯汀都给红牛带来了困难，但维斯塔潘确认，该领域已取得进展——至少内部如此。
“嗯，我觉得无线电通讯好多了。在墨西哥，我们也尝试了一些东西，可能还有几个微小的设置需要调整到位。
“但实际上，车队听我说话非常清楚。也许其他人听不清，但说实话，这太棒了。所以我们其实应该努力保持这样！”
detailEn: "Unacceptable downshifts" – Max Verstappen explains what's behind a recurring F1 radio complaint
Verstappen says his main aim in speaking out over the team radio is to keep Red Bull on its toes. In Brazil, however, downshifts were not the four-time world champion's only complaint

Verstappen finished the opening practice session of the Formula 1 weekend in Sao Paulo in third place, just over two tenths behind fastest man Lando Norris in the upgraded McLaren, which features a new front wing that serves as the baseline for 2027.

Although the start looked promising in terms of outright pace, Verstappen was not entirely satisfied with the feeling in his RB22 on Friday afternoon. Over the team radio, a complaint emerged that is often heard from the four-time world champion: a less-than-ideal feeling during downshifts.

"Unacceptable man. Unacceptable, these downshifts. What the f***!", Verstappen told race engineer Tom Hart during the opening practice session. Hart is once again standing in for Gianpiero Lambiase this weekend as the pair continue to develop their working relationship for the future.

Although Verstappen knows it may come across as complaining, he explained in Brazil that such radio messages are mainly down to his perfectionism and are intended to keep the team on its toes for the moments in a race weekend that really matter.
"With the shifts or whatever that you hear me complain about, it's just because I'm never satisfied, because I think certain things can always be better", Verstappen explained.

"I always try to fine-tune or find improvements. So, if you hear it as complaining or whatever, it's more for me to make sure that the team is always looking into the details to try and find more lap time because I know there is more lap time in it."

The feeling during downshifts is not just about the gear change itself, but also the destabilisation of the car it can cause – particularly at the rear. This mainly happens under braking and is linked to the driver's confidence in the car, meaning it can cost lap time in that respect as well. It explains why Verstappen keeps emphasising the issue and why the subject comes up every weekend.
The incident with Stroll during practice starts explained

At Interlagos, however, that was not the only issue during the opening practice session. Verstappen also complained about the steering feeling heavy, which appeared to point to a problem with the power steering. Red Bull acknowledged that the issue was also visible in the data, after which Verstappen joked during a visit to the pitlane: "It’s a work-out with this steering!"

While Verstappen had to work harder because of the steering problem, the most extreme example in FP1 was seen with Lance Stroll. Onboard footage of the Canadian showed almost full steering lock in three consecutive corners, something that is certainly not normal at those points on the circuit.

At the end of the session, Verstappen and Stroll also encountered each other in a battle for a position for the practice starts. The Red Bull driver had been instructed by his team to carry out his practice start on the right-hand side of the grid after two burnouts, where the grip level is naturally different because of the ideal racing line.

Stroll wanted to pass Verstappen to claim that particular grid position for himself. The Dutchman was having none of it, however, and overtook the Aston Martin again, after which Stroll accepted defeat and had to carry out his practice start on the left-hand side – the dirtier side of the grid.
Has Red Bull finally solved its radio problem?

Another issue appears to have improved in Mexico and, so far, in Brazil: the team radio. The problem caused Red Bull difficulties in both Singapore and Austin, but Verstappen confirms that progress has been made in that area – at least internally.
"Well, the radio is, I think, a lot better. In Mexico, we were also trying some things, and it's just a few tiny settings probably to still get right.
"But actually, the team was hearing me very well. Maybe everyone else was not, but that's fantastic, to be honest. So we should actually try and keep it that way!"
keyPointsZh: 诺里斯的迈凯伦带有新前翼，该前翼是2027年的基准。
维斯塔潘表示，他在无线电中发声的主要目的是让红牛保持警觉。
在巴西，降挡并不是这位四届世界冠军唯一的抱怨。
keyPointsEn: Norris's McLaren features a new front wing that serves as the baseline for 2027.
Verstappen says his main aim in speaking out over the team radio is to keep Red Bull on its toes.

items.originalTitle: F1 champion Kimi Antonelli plans special purchase after historic title win
items.summaryEn: Antonelli clinched the 2026 Formula 1 world championship at the Mexican Grand Prix, becoming the youngest champion in F1 history. He revealed that he plans to reward himself with a new car, noting that his parents keep a close eye on how he spends his money.
detailZh: F1世界冠军安东内利在历史性夺冠后计划进行特别采购
新加冕的F1世界冠军安东内利透露了他庆祝夺冠的计划
赛道之外的赛车文化。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计，以及让赛车超越运动本身的故事。
安东内利透露了他打算如何犒赏自己赢得2026年F1世界冠军。
尽管父母一直密切关注他的花钱方式，这位意大利车手告诉《米兰体育报》，他打算犒劳自己一辆新车。
这位20岁的车手上周末在墨西哥大奖赛上锁定总冠军，成为F1历史上最年轻的冠军。
安东内利对这家意大利媒体表示：“我父母一直试图教我金钱的价值，现在我开始赚到可观的收入，他们想确保知道我怎么花、花在哪里。但可以说，跟我打交道这事挺容易的，因为我不是那种有昂贵爱好的人。”
他说自己的大部分钱都花在日常事物上，而他最大的享受就是他的赛车模拟器。
“我家里有模拟器，所以我就靠它找乐子，”这位梅赛德斯车手解释道。“我不需要去购物。我把钱花在食物、家里用的东西、汽油上……然后给自己买几条新赛道在模拟器上开。”
尽管他尽量在花钱上保持谨慎，但他补充说，汽车是他的例外。
“这么说吧，我父母得盯着我的地方就是车，因为有几辆我真的很想买。所以我想，我会为了赢得总冠军犒劳自己一辆，”他补充道。
安东内利还有一种稍微不那么传统的庆祝夺冠的方式，他透露自己仍打算兑现染发的承诺。
“我已经拿到喷雾罐了！现在我只得决定是这周末就动手，还是等到下周我去布拉克利的工厂、得在所有员工面前讲话的时候再说，”他说，“染着头发出现在那里会很有趣。”
detailEn: F1 champion Kimi Antonelli plans special purchase after historic title win
Newly crowned Formula 1 world champion Kimi Antonelli has revealed his plans to celebrate his title victory
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
Kimi Antonelli has revealed how he plans to reward himself for winning the 2026 Formula 1 world championship.
Despite his parents keeping a close eye on how he spends his money, the Italian driver told La Gazzetta dello Sport that he is going to treat himself to a new car.
The 20-year-old clinched the title at the Mexican Grand Prix last weekend, becoming the youngest champion in F1 history.

"My parents have always tried to teach me the value of money, and now that I’m earning significant amounts, they want to make sure they know how I spend it and where," Antonelli told the Italian publication. "But let’s say it’s a fairly easy job with me, because I’m not someone who has expensive hobbies."
He said most of his money goes on everyday things, and that his main indulgence is his racing simulator.

"I have my simulator at home, so I have fun with that," the Mercedes driver explained. "I don’t need to go shopping. I spend money on food, things for the house, petrol... and then I buy myself some new tracks to drive on the simulator."
While he tries to be careful with money, he added that cars are his exception.
"Let’s say that what my parents have to keep an eye on me about is cars, because there are a couple I’d really like to buy. So I think I’ll treat myself to one for winning the title," he added.
Antonelli also has a slightly more unconventional way to celebrate his title, revealing that he still plans to keep his promise to dye his hair.

"I’ve got the cans! Now I just have to decide whether to do it this weekend or maybe wait until next week when I go to the factory in Brackley and have to speak in front of all the employees," he said. "It would be fun to turn up there with dyed hair."
keyPointsZh: 他是在接受《米兰体育报》（La Gazzetta dello Sport）采访时透露购车计划的。
keyPointsEn: He revealed his plan to buy a new car in an interview with La Gazzetta dello Sport.

items.originalTitle: “Unfiltered” Lewis Hamilton is ready to exploit Charles Leclerc’s “silly” move, says Martin Brundle
detailZh: “未经过滤”的汉密尔顿准备利用勒克莱尔在墨西哥的“愚蠢”举动，马丁·布伦德尔如是说
马丁·布伦德尔批评勒克莱尔在墨西哥第一圈时的“愚蠢”举动，警告一个未经过滤的汉密尔顿正在玩政治游戏
对于法拉利车迷来说。这是最新的Scuderia 法拉利 F1新闻，车手更新，技术分析和来自马拉内洛及更远处的比赛反应
当勒克莱尔在墨西哥赛道4号弯处选择将脚留在草地上而不是让出位置给汉密尔顿时，他不仅得到了5秒的罚时，还在法拉利车队中引发了戏剧性的场面。
现在，随着车棚为巴西大奖赛搭建营地，经验丰富的天空体育广播员马丁·布伦德尔对第一圈混乱的情况提出了自己的评估。并且剧透一下：他并不完全支持摩纳哥车手的决策。
周四在伊纳戈斯赛道，布伦德尔猛烈抨击了勒克莱尔对其队友的激进挤压。他指出，由此产生的场外冒险和团队内部争吵最终摧毁了法拉利赢得重大比赛胜利的机会。
“最大的新闻是这给了马克斯·维斯塔潘胜利，”布伦德尔直言不讳地说。"这并不是查尔斯职业生涯中最明智的举动。那是一个75-25的反对队友的举动。这不是一个明智的举动。"
在事故发生后，汉密尔顿在车队无线电中非常愤怒，公开质疑国际汽联的逻辑，并对法拉利的维修区发出了含蓄的警告。虽然一些评论员（如拉尔夫·舒马赫）批评这位老将公开在广播中揭露脏衣服，但布伦德尔却完全不同。
根据前F1车手，汉密尔顿非常清楚自己在做什么。
“刘易斯正处于职业生涯的一个阶段，他将不会受到任何过滤，”布鲁恩德解释道，指出这位老将完全没有兴趣为了公关部门而表现得和善。
布鲁恩德指出，勒克莱尔被处以的五秒时间罚分在实际上对体育影响甚微，汉密尔顿在无线电中对此提出了质疑。
查尔斯·勒克莱尔，法拉利，刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利
“他在无线电里说，裁判给了查尔斯五秒的罚分，这肯定值得稍微走一些捷径，领先出来，你将赢得超过五秒，”布伦德尔强调了这一点。
通过积极表达他的不满并指出罚分系统的缺陷，汉密尔顿正在对赛事控制和法拉利车队负责人弗雷德·瓦瑟尔施加巨大压力。这是一场计算过的心理战，布伦德尔认为汉密尔顿正在充分利用勒克莱尔犯下的错误，以在车库里确立他的统治地位。
“刘易斯意识到这里有一个机会实际上可以缩小一些差距，因为那确实有点愚蠢，”布伦德尔总结道。
在本周末的伊纳戈斯赛道上，两位车手都希望反弹，法拉利维修区可能需要不仅仅是一次闭门会议来阻止他们再次发生碰撞。
detailEn: “Unfiltered” Lewis Hamilton is ready to exploit Charles Leclerc’s “silly” move, says Martin Brundle
Martin Brundle has criticised Charles Leclerc for his "silly" Lap 1 move in Mexico, warning that an unfiltered Lewis Hamilton is playing the political game
For Ferrari fans. The latest Scuderia Ferrari F1 news, driver updates, technical analysis and race reaction from Maranello and beyond.

When Charles Leclerc decided to keep his foot planted across the grass at Turn 4 in Mexico rather than yield to Lewis Hamilton, he didn't just earn a five-second penalty - he sparked drama across the Ferrari team.

Now, as the paddock sets up camp for the Brazilian Grand Prix, veteran Sky Sports broadcaster Martin Brundle has offered his own assessment of the Lap 1 chaos. And spoiler alert: he isn't exactly defending the Monegasque driver's decision-making.

Speaking at Interlagos on Thursday, Brundle tore into Leclerc's aggressive squeeze on his team-mate. He noted that the resulting off-track excursion and intra-team squabbling ultimately destroyed Ferrari's chances of securing a massive race win.

“The big story was it gave Max Verstappen the victory," Brundle stated, cutting straight to the point. "It wasn’t the smartest move in Charles’s career. That was a 75-25 move against your team-mate. It wasn’t a smart move."

Hamilton was absolutely furious over the team radio following the incident, openly questioning the FIA's logic and delivering a thinly veiled warning to the Ferrari pitwall. While some pundits (such as Ralf Schumacher) criticised the veteran for airing dirty laundry over the airwaves, Brundle sees it completely differently.
According to the former F1 driver, Hamilton knows exactly what he is doing.
“Lewis is at a stage of his career where he will be unfiltered," Brundle explained, pointing out that the veteran has absolutely zero interest in playing nice for the PR department.
Brundle noted that the five-second time penalty handed to Leclerc did little in terms of actual sporting impact, and Hamilton called it out on the radio.
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari

“He said on the radio that they the stewards had given Charles the win with the five-second penalty, and it was definitely worth cutting a few corners and getting out in front, you will make more than five seconds," Brundle highlighted.

By actively voicing his frustration and pointing out the flaws in the penalty system, Hamilton is applying massive pressure on both race control and Ferrari team principal Fred Vasseur. It's a calculated psychological play, and Brundle believes Hamilton is fully leveraging Leclerc's mistake to assert his dominance within the garage.
“Lewis has realised here’s a chance to actually make a bit of ground on this because that was a bit silly," Brundle concluded.
With both drivers looking to bounce back at Interlagos this weekend, the Ferrari pitwall could need more than a closed-door meeting to stop these two from trading paint again.

items.originalTitle: Colton Herta qualifies for F1 superlicence as Valtteri Bottas remains bullish on 2027 seat
items.summaryEn: Cadillac F1 test driver Colton Herta completed his sixth Friday practice session of the 2026 season at Interlagos, reaching the 100km threshold to earn his 40th superlicence point and become eligible to race in F1. Incumbent Valtteri Bottas remains bullish on his future with the team.
detailZh: 赫塔获F1超级驾照资格，博塔斯对2027席位仍乐观
凭借在巴西大奖赛的最新一次F1练习赛出场，凯迪拉克车队的科尔顿·赫塔拿到了参加F1比赛所需的最后一个驾照积分。
凯迪拉克F1测试车手科尔顿·赫塔终于获得了参加该系列赛所需的最后一个超级驾照积分，但现役车手瓦尔特利·博塔斯对自己在车队的未来仍持乐观态度。
赫塔在英特拉格斯完成了2026赛季第六次周五练习赛，达到100公里的里程门槛，从而拿到参加F1所需的第40个超级驾照积分。
凯迪拉克认为这位前印地赛车王牌上周在墨西哥已经达到了那个门槛，但很快就有消息传出，由于他此前印地赛车成绩的混乱，这位加州人仍差一分。这支美国所有的车队通过让赫塔在塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯的车里再跑一次周五第一节练习赛，纠正了那个错误。
这让车队得以保持选择余地，因为它正在考虑是让现任的博塔斯与佩雷斯搭档再留一年，还是在2027年让赫塔完成他的F1首秀。
凯迪拉克为培养赫塔并确保他持续参加第一节练习赛所投入的时间、精力和金钱表明，车队决心最早在明年提拔这位26岁的美国人。
但博塔斯对在2027年保住自己的席位态度乐观，并表示在经历了与问题重重的凯迪拉克MAC-26赛车共度的艰难一年后，他对围绕自己席位的传闻程度感到困惑。除了赫塔之外，还有几位其他车手要么与凯迪拉克进行了私下会谈，要么公开申请博塔斯的席位，比如梅赛德斯储备车手弗雷德里克·维斯蒂。
博塔斯周四表示：“我对这件事引发的噪音感到相当惊讶，因为我知道自己的处境。而且我听到的所有消息都是，车队对我所做的工作很满意。”
“但与此同时，我们知道这项运动是如何运作的。每个人都想进入F1，如果有人看到某个地方有机会，他们就会想方设法去争取。”
“但以我们车队的架构方式以及未来决策的制定方式，一切都需要董事会批准。我相信那次会议还没有召开。我一直确信没有任何变化。”
与队友佩雷兹相比，博塔斯表现不佳，但他也遭遇了凯迪拉克首款赛车带来的诸多问题，最近一次是在墨西哥因悬挂故障发生高速事故。这让这位芬兰老将的表现更难评判，但这位10次分站冠军得主坚称，合适的人知道如何评价他。
“我认为懂的人自然懂，这就是我的感受。而且我在那一边有很好的支持，”这位37岁的车手说道。“目前我们有比车手更大的问题需要解决，我认为墨西哥站就是一个很好的例子。
“车队知道如果一切顺利，他们能从我身上得到什么。但到目前为止，他们并没有真正交付一辆我能有所作为的赛车。但说实话，第一年我一直都是这么预期的。我来这里是为了尝试为未来改善一些事情，绝对不是抱着为我的席位而战的心态。”
detailEn: Colton Herta qualifies for F1 superlicence as Valtteri Bottas remains bullish on 2027 seat
With his latest Formula 1 practice outing at the Brazilian Grand Prix, Cadillac's Colton Herta has earned the final missing licence point needed to race in F1.

Cadillac F1 test driver Colton Herta has finally obtained the last remaining superlicence point required to drive in the series, but incumbent Valtteri Bottas remains bullish on his future with the squad.
Herta conducted his sixth Friday practice session of the 2026 season at Interlagos, reaching the required threshold of 100km to earn his 40th superlicence point needed to race in F1.

Cadillac believed the former IndyCar ace had reached that threshold last week in Mexico, but it soon emerged the Californian was still one point shy amid confusion over his previous IndyCar results. The US-owned squad rectified that error by handing Herta another Friday FP1 session in Sergio Perez's car.
That allows the team to keep its options open as it considers retaining incumbent Bottas for a second year alongside Perez or handing Herta his F1 debut in 2027.

The amount of time, energy and money spent by Cadillac to prepare Herta and ensure he kept churning out FP1 sessions suggests that the team is set on promoting the 26-year-old American as early as next year.

But Bottas was bullish on retaining his seat for 2027 and said he was bemused by the extent of the rumours around his seat after a difficult year with the troubled Cadillac MAC-26. Alongside Herta, several other drivers have either held private talks with Cadillac or publicly applied for Bottas' seat, like Mercedes reserve driver Frederik Vesti.
"I've been quite surprised about the amount of noise on that," Bottas said on Thursday. "Because I know what my situation is. And all I've heard, the team has been happy with what I'm doing.
"But at the same time, we know how this sport works. Everyone wants to be in F1 and if somebody sees an opportunity somewhere, they're going to try and go for it one way or the other.

"But the way our team is structured and the way decisions are made for the future, everything needs to be approved by the board. And I believe that meeting is still yet to happen. I've been convinced nothing has changed."

Bottas has underperformed compared to team-mate Perez, but has also dealt with numerous issues with Cadillac's debut car, the latest coming in the shape of a high-speed accident in Mexico due to a suspension failure. That has made the Finnish veteran's performances tougher to judge, but the 10-time race winner insists the right people know how to appraise him.

"I think the people who know, they know. That's what I feel like. And I've got good support on that side," the 37-year-old said. "We have bigger problems to solve than the drivers at the moment and I think Mexico was a good example.

"The team knows what they can get out of me if everything works well. But so far, they haven't really delivered with a car that I can do much. But honestly, that was always what I kind of expected for the first year. I came here to try and improve things for the future, definitely not with a mindset to fight for my seat."
keyPointsZh: 赫塔此次是在巴西大奖赛的周五练习赛中完成所需里程。
博塔斯目前是凯迪拉克车队的现役车手，他对2027年席位仍持乐观态度。
keyPointsEn: Herta reached the required mileage during the Friday practice session at the Brazilian Grand Prix.
Bottas is the team's incumbent driver and remains bullish on a 2027 seat.
